project_scope_description.value: Design and construction services for fire protection system upgrades across eight buildings at the Baghdad Diplomatic Support Center compound, including fire alarm replacement, wet pipe sprinkler installation, new fire pump house, underground fire main replacement and extension, sitework tie-ins, and AFFF system removal. Compound occupies 147 hectares adjacent to Baghdad International Airport.
project_scope_description.quote: The project involves the Fire Protection System upgrades for eight (8) buildings on the Baghdad BDSC compound to include fire alarms and fire suppression in compliance with OBO International Building Code.

drawings.reading_notes: No drawing set PDFs present in intake folder. The CD-3 submittal lighting calculation and mechanical calculation PDFs (dated April 24, 2025) appear to be design calculation submittals rather than drawing sheets. Calculations by Bowman, Foster & Associates, Inc. (mechanical) and IEP (lighting) — these appear to be design firm sub-team members or the BFA team name in use. Lighting calcs reference Drawing No. E101 for B602 corridor areas. No architectural, structural, or fire protection drawing sheets are present.

conflict_flags.resolution_chosen: FUTRON and FPLS ENGINEERING STATEMENT OF WORK FOR DESIGN SERVICES FPLS Markup.docx
conflict_flags.rationale: The FPLS sub-SOW is dated April 2024 (later than the April 2023 prime SOW) and reflects evolved scope including new CLINs 004 and 005. The foam systems in the hangars are an expansion of scope via additional CLINs. The prime SOW represents the baseline; the sub-SOW represents the current executed scope. Not a true conflict — scope was expanded.
